Synopsis

JFrog listed @coveops/abi 2.0.1 among the September 2025 npm phishing follow-on packages. The malicious release carried the same browser wallet-drainer family as the wider Qix campaign.

Story

JFrog identified @coveops/abi as a follow-on package in the September 2025 npm phishing campaign. It was not part of the original Qix maintainer package set, so it is modeled as a separate official npm distribution surface.

The payload family targeted browser-side cryptocurrency activity. Public advisories describe malicious code that monitored web3 traffic and attempted to redirect transactions to attacker-controlled addresses.
